_comment: Every MapLibre interface string, by MapLibre's own ID. Renderer::map_ui_json() must translate exactly the 'sent' ones (tests/MapUiTest.php); 'notShown' says why each of the others never appears on these maps. tests/js/map-ui.test.ts checks that the two lists together are MapLibre's full set, so a string a MapLibre update adds fails the tests until it is sorted into one of them.

notShown.AttributionControl.MapFeedback: MapLibre defines it but never uses it.
notShown.LogoControl.Title: The MapLibre logo is off.
notShown.Marker.Title: Only for a default pin with no name of its own, and keyboardMarker() names every pin before it is added to the map.
notShown.ScaleControl.Feet: The scale bar is always metric.
notShown.ScaleControl.Miles: The scale bar is always metric.
notShown.ScaleControl.NauticalMiles: The scale bar is always metric.
